from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9031a792.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    if not pts:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and grid[r][c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
# verify demo using concise construction
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo=[[4]*15 for _ in range(30)]
for r,c in [(9,5),(9,7),(10,7),(11,7),(12,7),(13,3),(13,5),(13,7)]: demo[r][c]=7
out=mod.transform(demo)
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r,c in [(9,3),(9,4),(9,6),(10,3),(11,3),(12,3),(13,4),(13,6)]: expected[r][c]=2
print('demo reproduced:',out==expected)

result=mod.transform(test)
